frequency_question: What proportion of emergency domestic missile production line setups achieve operational status within 42 days?
membership_rule: Includes any documented historical attempt by a nation at war to initiate domestic manufacturing/assembly of a foreign high-tech cruise missile system. Excludes standard peacetime transfers which take years.

cases.name: Ukraine Neptune missile domestic production scaling (2022-2024)
Pakistan Babur cruise missile indigenous establishment
Iran Soumar/Qods cruise missile reverse engineering and assembly setup

coverage_note: 4 named instances of major sovereign guided-weapon line establishments under duress; 1 met ultra-rapid deployment metrics.
known_gaps: Classified military projects involving underground or rapid dispersion manufacturing are unrecorded in open literature.
skeleton: Total emergency advanced weapons localization attempts in modern history; subset achieving operational assembly in under two months.
multiplier: 1 hit out of 4 documented major attempts at rapid domestic high-tech missile line establishments under severe constraints.
validity_reason: Defense industrial base velocity metrics change slowly over decades barring radical automation shifts.
